title: Magnitude to release SSD expert-streaming engine for sparse MoE models, claims DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 40+ tok/s on one gaming GPU

appearances.title: Magnitude tunes local kernels, measured 2.7x vs Ollama
appearances.summary: Magnitude is an Apache-2.0 Rust inference engine that compiles and tunes a model's GPU kernels on the machine it runs on, then connects to Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Pi. On a base M5 MacBook Pro with Qwen3.5 4B at 4-bit and the same 9.2k-token prompt, a hands-on test measured 60 tok/s decode versus 22.6 for Ollama and about half the end-to-end time.
